description: Golden question set for the Recall DEMO. Every question and answer is drawn from the fictional sample_notes/ corpus (persona: Sam Carter, owner of a café + roastery). No real personal or business data. The runner (run_eval.py) scores two things per item: (1) RETRIEVAL - did any note whose label contains one of expected_sources get pulled into the sources? (2) ANSWER - does the written answer contain the facts in expected_facts? A fact that is a plain string must appear; a fact that is a list passes if ANY of its options appears (used to allow number formatting or wording variants). Add or edit items freely - this file is the whole quiz.

items.question: What is my emergency fund target?
